title: Reservation sensitivity scenarios & region-shift model (March 2029)
content:
One-line summary: This working sheet models per-contract reserved GPU allocations under three region-shift sensitivity scenarios (Baseline, APAC-upweight, EU-contraction) and a downstream H100 substitution curve. The goal is to produce a pragmatic reallocation plan and decision points for sales & customer success for contracts that want region flexibility or elective instance-type upgrades.

Context and motivation:
- We have ~3 months of inbound demand signals showing a shifting footprint: APAC reservations up ~28% month-over-month for early-2029 trials; EU reserved hours trending down as several enterprise pilots move to Dedicated but deferred.
- Several long-tail contracts include flexible-region clauses; product & legal want a recommended approach for reassigning slabs without breaking SLAs or contractual utilization guarantees.
- Hardware lifecycle: customers on A100-equivalent SKUs may opt-in to H100s; H100 substitution reduces slot count requirement but changes throughput/price. Need to show sensitivity.

Assumptions (inputs used in scenarios):
- Time horizon: Mar 2029 through Aug 2029 (6 months).
- GPU classes: A100-40GB (legacy), H100-80GB (new). Conversion factor assumption: 1 H100 ≈ 1.8 A100 for typical RLHF/chat workloads (workload-dependent).
- Baseline utilization target per-contract: 55% sustained over month (reservations counted at committed peak hour capacity).
- Burst-to-reserved conversion allowed up to 10% of reserved capacity on short notice windows (customer-tier dependent).
- Region latency constraints: customers in EU cannot be migrated to APAC without explicit consent; internal policy allows intra-USA shifting for SMBs.

Sample per-contract projection (sheet view):
Columns: ContractID | Customer | CurrentRegion | GPU_Type | Reserved_GPU_Count | MonthlyUtilTarget | PhaseStart(Mar) | PhaseEnd(Aug) | FlexClause | Notes
Rows (examples):
C-3491 | LumaHealth | us-west | A100 | 42 | 55% | 42 | 42 | no | enterprise, fixed latency SLA
C-3628 | Nimbus Retail | eu-west | A100 | 16 | 55% | 12 | 8 | yes | propose partial reassign to us-west if EU usage < 40% over 2 months
C-3775 | AeroDocs | ap-southeast1 | A100 | 24 | 55% | 24 | 36 | yes | APAC pilot; request H100 migration opt-in in May
C-4012 | FinSentry | eu-west | A100 | 64 | 55% | 64 | 48 | contract-neg | high compliance, needs EU-only
C-4099 | BlueCart | us-east | H100 | 8 | 55% | 8 | 8 | no | already on H100 small slab

Scenario definitions and headroom math (summary):
1) Baseline: keep current region allocations; apply conservative H100 migration adoption ramp (5% of eligible customer slots convert in Apr, 12% by Jun).
- Total reserved GPUs (A100 equiv): Mar: 190, Apr: 188, May: 185, Jun: 182, Jul: 180, Aug: 178
2) APAC-upweight: APAC demand +35% by May driven by channel partner; 8 of 24 APAC contracts request expansion; we allow migration of 10% from EU flexible contracts to APAC where contract permits.
- Total reserved GPUs (A100 equiv): Mar: 190, Apr: 196, May: 215, Jun: 210, Jul: 205, Aug: 200
3) EU-contraction: EU demand -30% by Apr as two pilots delay; legal requires offers for pro-rated credits or region substitution. We plan reassignments to US or enable burst reallocation.
- Total reserved GPUs (A100 equiv): Mar: 190, Apr: 174, May: 160, Jun: 158, Jul: 155, Aug: 152

H100 substitution sensitivity (applied to each scenario):
- Conservative: conversion factor 1.5x (H100 replaces 1.5 A100s).
- Nominal: 1.8x (base assumption).
- Aggressive: 2.0x (high-throughput workloads).
Effect: reduces physical GPU count requirement but increases per-GPU throughput, impacting batch sizing and pricing. Show example: A contract with 36 A100-equivalent slots could be satisfied by 20 H100s at nominal factor (36/1.8 ≈ 20).

Per-region pro forma totals (nominal H100 conversion applied where customers opt-in):
- Baseline (Mar->Aug totals shown as A100-equivalent reserved): US: 98 -> 94, EU: 60 -> 56, APAC: 32 -> 28
- APAC-upweight: US: 88 -> 84, EU: 54 -> 46, APAC: 48 -> 70
- EU-contraction: US: 110 -> 106, EU: 60 -> 42, APAC: 20 -> 24

Operational constraints & rules used by the model:
- Hard constraints: cannot move contract data residency or compliance-bound GPUs out of region without signed amendment.
- Soft constraints: economic preference to replace A100 with H100 within same region to preserve network locality and reduce cross-region egress costs.
- Prioritization: when reallocating freed capacity, prioritize (1) committed enterprise SLAs, (2) existing Dedicated customers with active business reviews, (3) new trials with signed NDA.

Decision points for Sales/CS (for each contract marked 'yes' in FlexClause):
- Offer A: pro-rated credits for delayed region capacity (standard legal template: Credit-Region-2028-v2).
- Offer B: region substitution to alternative region (with latency waiver and discount).
- Offer C: elective H100 upgrade with migration discount and migration SOW.
Recommend default: Offer B for SMBs where latency delta < 40ms and customer consents via signed amendment; Offer C for high-usage customers wanting cost/throughput efficiency.

Risk notes:
- Rapid H100 adoption in APAC could create temporary scarcity for H100 spares in US; need cross-pool borrowing rules (see linked INF ticket).
- Billing system rounding: switching customers mid-month from A100 to H100 requires audit of tokenized usage conversion; estimate reconciliation delta up to 1.2% per month.

Appendix: quick step-through calculation example (C-3775 AeroDocs):
- Current reserved: 24 A100s. Customer requests H100 migration in May. Nominal factor 1.8 => required H100s = ceil(24 / 1.8) = 14 H100s.
- If APAC demand grows, we can reassign 4 extra A100 equiv from flex pool making physical allocation in May: 10 H100s + 4 A100 equiv burst => contiguous coverage.

Action items & owners (next 2 weeks):
- Marco Chen: run slot-level bin-packing sim for APAC pools with H100 substitution parameter sweep (deliver CSV + heatmap by 2029-03-20).
- Sophia Rivera: draft customer amendment language for region-substitution (legal review requested, due 2029-03-22).
- Aisha Patel (owner): prioritize contracts with FlexClause true and prepare outreach list (top 15 by reserved value) by 2029-03-18.

Questions outstanding / follow-ups:
- Confirm OSS metrics for RLHF throughput equivalence; request research bench run (ticket INF-4803).
- Are we comfortable with internal policy to temporarily borrow H100s across regions for an emergency SLA (yes/no)?

Notes on provenance: this is an internal working sheet — numbers are model outputs and should be validated by infra sim and finance before customer communication. Use linked artifacts to trace to tickets and the legal template.

Bottom line recommendation (working): accept region-substitution offers for flexible SMB contracts in exchange for 6-month commitment extension or pro-rated credits; prioritize elective H100 migrations for high-util contracts where conversion reduces total reserved physical units and improves overall fleet economics.
